products.title: The Shoal Simple Sunday Bag
products.body_html:
The Shoal Simple Sunday Bag was designed around a straightforward idea: carry what you need and leave the rest behind. Made from waxed canvas, it is a lightweight, uncomplicated bag suited to quick rounds, practice sessions, and golfers who prefer to walk with less.

Its soft construction has no internal support rod, allowing the bag to fold easily for travel or storage. An 8-inch top with a single divider keeps the design simple, while the single strap provides a traditional carrying experience. “Crafted for the walk” is embroidered on the interior of the lower center pocket, and the Shoal dog logo is embossed on the bottom of the bag.

Product Specs:

  • Waxed canvas construction

  • 2.65 lbs.

  • 8-inch top

  • Single divider

  • Single strap

  • Soft, unstructured construction

  • No internal support rod

  • Easily foldable and storable

  • “Crafted for the walk” embroidered on the interior of the lower center pocket

  • Shoal dog logo embossed on the bottom

products.title: Shoal Golf Co. Cotton Canvas Hat
products.body_html:
A classic cotton canvas golf cap built with a timeless approach.

Featuring an embroidered Shoal Golf Co. patch, contrasting brim detail, and a structured silhouette, it draws inspiration from vintage club and tournament caps while remaining understated in its design. Built for everyday rounds and made to become a staple over time.

One size fits all. Adjustable for a custom fit.

products.title: Shoal Golf Co. Corduroy Hat
products.body_html:
A vintage-inspired corduroy golf cap built with the same restrained approach behind Shoal Golf Co.

Designed with a structured silhouette and finished with embroidered Shoal script detailing, it pairs classic materials with an understated look made for everyday wear — on the course and beyond. Clean in its design and intentionally simple, it’s built to age well and become a familiar piece over time.

One size fits all. Adjustable for a custom fit.

products.title: Shoal X No Dirt Caddie Towel White with Green Stripes
products.body_html:
Made in collaboration with No Dirt, the Shoal Caddy Towel combines the traditional size of a tour towel with a built-in scrub pad designed specifically for the game.

Measuring 44" × 22", it provides plenty of coverage for keeping clubs clean and dry while still hanging naturally over your bag.

What sets it apart:

  1. Tour size
    Generously sized to handle rain, morning dew, sand, and dirt throughout the round.
  2. Built-in scrub pad
    An integrated, non-abrasive pad helps remove dirt from clubfaces and grooves without the need for a separate brush.
  3. Made for the course
    The textured weave lifts dirt and absorbs moisture rather than simply moving it across the club.

Thoughtfully designed for long practice sessions, early morning rounds, and everything in between. A proper caddy towel, made to work as well as it looks.

products.title: The Shoal Standard Bag - Salmon
products.body_html:
The Shoal Standard Bag

Built on the belief that golf is better when walked, The Standard is Shoal’s signature carry bag.

Designed with restraint, it favors thoughtful simplicity over unnecessary features. Every material, seam, and pocket serves a purpose, creating a bag that balances naturally on the shoulder and quietly disappears into the walk.

Constructed from premium waxed canvas and leather accents, The Standard was made for everyday rounds and built to develop character through years of use. It is equally at home on a century-old club or a municipal course, carrying the same appreciation for timeless golf.

Inspired by warm summer evenings and faded coastal tones, Salmon brings a subtle personality to The Standard without sacrificing its timeless design. Distinctive yet restrained, it offers a fresh interpretation of a classic walking bag.

Features

  • Water-resistant 16 oz. waxed canvas body
  • Premium leather accents
  • Structured 4-way divider designed for balance and club separation
  • Stable, low-profile stand system
  • Large zippered belly pocket for easy access to items at the bottom of the bag
  • Includes both single and double shoulder straps
  • 6.4 lbs.*

*Weight without straps.

products.title: The Shoal Shag Bag
products.body_html:
Built for the range, the short-game area, and the back of the cart.

The Shoal Shag Bag is made from premium waxed canvas with a simple drawstring closure and canvas carry handle. Designed to hold roughly 60–65 golf balls, it is a clean, durable way to carry practice balls without the look of a standard mesh range bag.

Finished with the same understated character as our carry bags, it is a practical accessory for practice days, club events, member gifts, and everyday use.

Product Details

• Premium waxed canvas exterior
• Holds roughly 60–65 golf balls
• Nylon drawstring closure
• Canvas carry handle
• Lightweight and easy to store
• Limited quantity available
